name: batch_matmul_reduce_v2_audited_profile_development

correctness.golden: actual quantized input values -> FP64 BMM -> max N -> sum M -> FP32

timing.secondary_metric: host_us is diagnostic only; never substitute it for device duration
timing.invocation_audit: poison output, verify inputs/guards and capture every call outside measured compute task duration
timing.association: isolated serial single-case process; exactly one device compute task per call is declared and task count checked, not independently attested

score.aggregate: arithmetic mean across all 15 public performance shapes
score.reason: Frozen source is preserved; legacy measurements belong to the old package/harness/protocol identity and are not active v2 baselines

limitations: No accepted hostile-code isolation backend; legacy Host C++ shares the runner process
The 24 boundary shapes come from the inspectable old project; only evaluator seed/input realizations are resampled
Repeated calls of one shape are covered; cross-shape process-state transitions are not
Development-only scores; same-process Host code is not an adversarially trusted measurement boundary
